test_evidence: pg-audit-chain-keyed.live.test.ts (runtime role proctira_app, FORCE RLS, throwaway PG, migrations 291-296): 8 blocks incl forged-unkeyed-chain rejected by keyed verifier, runtime UPDATE audit_chain_heads denied, broken prev_hash rejected, runtime write to audit_chain_cutover denied, 20-concurrent contiguous chain, cross-tenant definer calls raise 42501, double-seal exactly 10 entries + sealed guard. 8/8 pass; revert of the 3 source files + reverted 292/293 on the same DB = 8/8 FAIL exit 1; restore + re-apply = 8/8 pass. tsc 0; eslint 0; prettier clean (SQL not prettier-managed) (evidence/M200-partG-pass.log, M200-partG-revert-proof.log)
notes: Topic 5 Option A approved 2026-10-27 (owner dbn1972). Scheduled in owner-tracks batch t1-audit-integrity-batch5. Keyed HMAC-SHA256 audit chain: key_id column (NULL=legacy), per-tenant cut-over chain_seq in audit_chain_cutover; the verifier accepts legacy sha256 rows only at/below the cut-over seq and requires HMAC with a known key_id above it. SECURITY DEFINER audit_chain_lock_head/append, audit_ingest_seal, audit_ingest_pending_tenants with 42501 tenant binding and EXECUTE revoked from PUBLIC then granted to proctira_app; runtime role keeps SELECT only on audit_chain_heads/cutover; audit_ingest_queue is append_only sealed only via the definer function. HMAC key via @proctira/secrets (aws-kms in prod); a deployed env refuses to boot without a real key and rejects the dev key_id. Two real defects surfaced+fixed in the same keyed-proof commit: 292/293 definer fns cast app_tenant_id() TEXT to uuid for the uuid tenant_id columns, and the verifyChain union projection now carries key_id so keyed rows are not read as unkeyed.
